heading: From College Labs to Production Floors
paragraphs: I'm a Senior Engineer L1 currently at FEV India, actively developing humanoid robotic systems on platforms like the Unitree G1 with Inspire dexterous hands. With 4+ years of hands-on experience, I design physics-accurate sim-to-real transfer workflows, simulation-based bipedal locomotion environments, safety wrappers, and robust hardware abstraction layers (HAL) that ground complex humanoid robots reliably in reality.

My journey started at RGIT's Robotics Club in Mumbai, where I led simulation and trained 50+ students. From there, I contributed to India's first Robotics Gallery at Gujarat Science City, working hands-on with Pepper humanoids, UR10 arms, Da Vinci surgical robots, SCARA systems, and autonomous mobile platforms.

At Wastefull Insights, I scaled from robotics engineer to senior engineer, architecting autonomous waste sorting systems that process 10,000+ objects daily. I refactored Python to C++ for up to 80% compute reduction, built multi-model YOLO pipelines with DeepStream, and developed analytics frameworks with 91% throughput prediction accuracy.
The theme has been consistent: take messy real-world problems and convert them into reliable, measurable systems.

tenets.title: Low-Latency Edge Determinism
tenets.body: Research prototypes in Python break down under sub-30ms industrial control cycles. I refactor critical perception bottlenecks to multithreaded C++ and serialize deep learning models into TensorRT FP16/INT8 engines on NVIDIA Jetson Xavier, slashing compute overhead by up to 80% while concurrently processing 4 RTSP feeds.
tenets.metricCallout: Up to 80% Compute Overhead Reduced · Sub-50ms Latency
tenets.evidenceTooltip: Measured via NVIDIA Nsight Systems on Jetson AGX Xavier: frame-to-decision latency reduced from 195ms to 42ms after migrating Python hot paths to multithreaded C++20 and TensorRT FP16/INT8.

tenets.title: Factory-Floor Ruggedness
tenets.body: True delivery means engineering for dust, camera vibration, and ambient factory lighting swings. I design industrial GigE line-scan vision setups, integrate synchronized strobe lighting, program Omron PLC safety interlocks, and architect watchdog auto-recovery loops ensuring 99.2%+ operational consistency.
tenets.metricCallout: 99.2% Defect Recall (<0.4% FAR) · PLC Safety Handshakes
tenets.evidenceTooltip: Evaluated on an annotated test dataset of 5,000 conveyor frames across 4 synchronized cameras under controlled industrial illumination, yielding <0.4% false acceptance rate.

tenets.title: Mechatronic & Motion Optimization
tenets.body: In production pick-and-place, milliseconds directly dictate facility throughput. By mathematically modeling and refining 3-axis gantry acceleration and S-curve motion profiles, I eliminated inertial losses by 15% and boosted picking cycle speed by up to 40%, coordinating multi-robot cells sorting 10,000+ items daily.
tenets.metricCallout: Up to 40% Cycle Speed Boost · 10,000+ Daily Objects
tenets.evidenceTooltip: Measured on 3-axis gantry picking cell by transitioning from trapezoidal motion profiles to jerk-limited S-curve acceleration curves. 10,000+ daily volume verified from operational shift logs.

tenets.title: Quantified Business ROI
tenets.body: Robotics engineering must produce verifiable economic impact. I built end-to-end telemetry pipelines streaming real-time vision analytics through Kafka and TimescaleDB, training regression models that predict facility throughput with 91% accuracy and slashing manual quality inspection labor by up to 60%.
tenets.metricCallout: Up to 60% Labor Reduction · 91% Prediction Precision
tenets.evidenceTooltip: Regression models predicted facility mass throughput against scale records with R^2 ~0.91 and MAPE <9%. Vision cell automated manual sorting lines, reducing required manual inspection stations from 5 down to 2 oversight operators.
